# Just a Book

> Just a Book is a minimal online document editor: write and organise documents without toolbars and clutter, with pages that grow with your text.

Made by Rinse Nieboer, Rotterdam. Built for people who want to write and keep their documents structured without folders in folders.

- [Maker](https://rjnieboer.com)
